sources.title: ACE-Step 1.5: The Complete 2026 Guide to Open-Source AI Music ...
sources.snippet: Released in January 2026, it represents a significant leap forward in the capability and accessibility of AI-powered music creation. At its core, ACE-Step 1.5 is a text-to-audio model that transforms simple text descriptions into full, high-fidelity music tracks — complete with melody, harmony, rhythm, instrumentation, and optionally, lyrics.
